**Request to the `domain:skills` seat that takes this card** · ⛔ not a claim. A second skills follow-up of the same family (Skills-docs owed by landed E1/E3 work), riding this card instead of a new one:

- PR #27387 (#26709 item 1, open draft at the time of writing) adds the declarative `providerConfig.include` on the `openapi` provider. Once it merges, two published lines become false and must change in the same skills PR: `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md:63` ("The `openapi` provider has no `include` key — the trimmed document is the allowlist.") and case 1's `expected_output` in `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` ("the `openapi` provider has no `include` key, so the trimmed document is the allowlist"), both read at `origin/main` 2026-10-29T05:10Z.
- ⛔ This item is for after #27387 merges, not before: until then those lines are true, and teaching `include` early would advertise an undelivered key. If this card is dispatched first, the original item (the handbook link) goes alone and this item stays here for the next pass.
